notes:
STRONG SINGLE PROMPT arm, rung n03 (3 named referents in the ledger: Marlpit ward, Dunmore Sixth Form College, the Second Chances course of Jan-Apr 2025). ONE call, finish_reason=stop, no retry, no repair, no edit. Output written to out-n03-D.md exactly as returned; the only removal was the tool's own trailing metadata line naming the model and generation id, which is transport annotation and not model output.

PROMPT: a single 2,576-word user message (no system prompt) carrying the full verbatim funder guidance, the published criteria and their weights, the organisation record, all 11 non-meta ledger items with source tags, an absolute grounding block (an explicit do-not-invent list covering staff/venue/street/partner/vendor names, registration numbers, statistics, past dates and prior results), an explicit instruction that a thin answer that is true beats a rich answer that is fabricated, permission to design the FUTURE freely, an internal-consistency block demanding the budget arithmetic close and one cohort structure carry through Q3/Q4/budget, a criteria-targeting block, an anti-LLM-register style brief, the verbatim required headings, and the 1,200-word hard limit with a 1,150-1,190 target. The fixture's synthetic status was stated in the prompt. No analyze stage, no org research, no voice stage, no strategy reservation, no design object, no validation loop, no claim ledger.

CALL PARAMETERS: max_tokens 12000, reasoning_effort low. Actual native usage 5,467 prompt / 3,225 completion, of which 556 were reasoning tokens. Cost is OpenRouter's own billed figure (total_cost 0.10796), not an estimate from token counts. Provider: Claude Platform on AWS, model permaslug anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723, latency 47.5s.

WORD COUNTS - counted with wc -w, not by any model. word_count 1427 is the whole file including headings, budget table and declaration, which is the same basis used for the other arms at this rung. The funder-relevant count is the five answers Q1-Q5 excluding heading lines: 1,172 words, measured by extracting the region from '## Q1.' to '## Budget table' and dropping lines beginning '## '. That is inside the 1,200 hard limit with 28 words of margin. Bullet text is counted; heading text is not, per the guidance.

ARITHMETIC VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY (python, not by a model): the eight direct-cost lines sum to 47,860 exactly as stated; 12 per cent of 47,860 is 5,743.20 and the single overhead line states 5,743, so it is at the cap and not over it; 47,860 + 5,743 = 53,603 which matches the stated total request and sits inside the GBP 25,000-75,000 band; the participant line 48 x GBP 120 = 5,760 as stated. The 15-month period is within the 18-month ceiling and starts April 2027, after the 12 February 2027 decision date. The 48-participant / 3-cohorts-of-16 structure carries through Q3, Q4 and the budget without drift.

GROUNDING AUDIT (manual, against the 11 ledger items): I found no invented fact about the applicant. Every past-tense claim traces to a ledger item - the 2016 constitution, 41,000 population, six staff / 4.2 FTE, 25 volunteers, GBP 214,000 expenditure and two years of accounts, the three service lines, three evenings a week in Marlpit, the 38 per cent lowest-decile figure at the 2021 census, the 27/18 college referral record and the 24/19/11 Second Chances record. No charity number was written or placeholdered. No staff, trustee, participant, venue, street, employer or vendor name was invented; the model referred to 'our Marlpit site', 'a sessional tutor we will contract' and 'local employers' by function, and signed the declaration with role titles only. All three available named referents were used. Q2 explicitly concedes that the evidence base is the applicant's own casework rather than a study, which is an honest move the ledger licenses.

HONEST WEAKNESSES OBSERVED: the derived figures in Q2 ('13 did not reach', 'nine did not enrol') are arithmetic on ledger items rather than ledger items themselves, which is legitimate inference but is the kind of thing a strict claim ledger would want to see classified rather than asserted flat. Some venue vagueness remains unavoidable - 'our Marlpit site' and 'the same building' name no building, because the ledger names none. The failure threshold in Q4 (fewer than 18 of 48 at week 26) is stated as roughly the rate already achieved without the new post, which is a defensible reading of 11/24 but is presented with more confidence than the two data points support.
